error.message: Saved target belongs to a process instance that is no longer running
error.suggestion: The target process exited. Run 'list-apps' to see whether the application runs again, launch it if it does not, then take a new snapshot
Run 'list-windows' to see available window IDs.

Re-run a snapshot and retry with a ref from the returned snapshot (CLI: snapshot, then use the printed @<snapshot_id>:eN ref; FFI: ad_snapshot then pass the printed qualified ref to ad_execute_by_ref). Snapshots are scoped to the session that took them, so take the snapshot under the same --session or AGENT_DESKTOP_SESSION you act with: one taken outside a session is not visible to a session-scoped action, and re-running it outside the session will fail the same way

error.message: Key combo 'alt+f4' is blocked for safety; pass --force to override
error.suggestion: Use an explicit mouse/focus command if physical interaction is intended

error.message: Saved ref was not proven unique when it was captured, so it cannot be re-identified safely
error.suggestion: Either another element in the window matched it, or the window could not be read whole within the snapshot timeout. For a large window, retake the snapshot with a larger --timeout-ms. Identical twins are refused again by every snapshot; where headed pointer input is available, an explicit --headed coordinate click can pick one.

error.message: Access is denied: the target window runs at a higher integrity level than the caller
error.suggestion: Run the terminal that launches agent-desktop elevated to the target's level, or act on an element that does not cross the boundary.
